genomes.name: Quick Dip, Two Legs
genomes.thesis: Buys the day after a 1% drop when the five-day loss is at least 1.9% and the index is above its 50-day mean, or any 2% drop above the 200-day. Out on the first 0.5% up day or after two sessions; 2.6% stop.

entry_rules.when: prev(ret1) < -0.01 and ret5 < -0.019 and close > sma50

genomes.rationale: Written by Claude in round three from the quick-flush leader's dip legs; scored exactly as written.
